items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology 8182 — Specification
items.description: Details which non-experimental methods and correlation concepts are examined, including scatter diagram interpretation.

items.title: SaveMyExams — AQA GCSE Psychology
items.description: Practice questions on correlation, questionnaires, case studies and observation methodologies.
